safety_precautions: use gloves when handling wood glue

steps.description: Assess the damage to the front left leg and determine if it can be repaired or needs replacement.
If the leg can be repaired, clean the broken edges and apply wood glue to both surfaces.
Align the broken pieces and use clamps to hold them together while the glue dries.
Once the glue is dry, sand the repaired area to smooth out any rough edges.
If necessary, apply wood filler to any gaps and sand again once dry.
Finish the leg with wood finish or paint if desired.

tips: Ensure the glue is suitable for wood repair.
Use clamps that provide even pressure.
Test the stability of the leg before using the chair.
